description.en: The island home of the nymph Calypso where Odysseus is held captive.
description.zh: 女神卡呂普索居住的島嶼，奧德修斯在此被困多年。

name.zh: 赫爾墨斯傳達宙斯的指令

description.en: Hermes visits Calypso on Ogygia to order the release of Odysseus.
description.zh: 赫爾墨斯來到奧吉吉亞島，命令卡呂普索釋放奧德修斯。

events.source_excerpt: Mercury, you are our messenger, go therefore and tell Calypso we have decreed that poor Ulysses is to return home.

name.en: Calypso helps Odysseus build a raft
name.zh: 卡呂普索協助奧德修斯建造木筏

description.en: Calypso provides tools and supplies for Odysseus to build a raft for his departure.
description.zh: 卡呂普索提供工具和補給，幫助奧德修斯建造木筏以便離開。

events.source_excerpt: She gave him a great bronze axe that suited his hands; it was sharpened on both sides, and had a beautiful olive-wood handle fitted firmly on to it.

description.en: Poseidon spots Odysseus at sea and conjures a violent storm that wrecks his vessel.
description.zh: 波塞冬在海上發現奧德修斯，掀起狂風巨浪摧毀了木筏。

events.source_excerpt: Thereon he gathered his clouds together, grasped his trident, stirred it round in the sea, and roused the rage of every wind that blows.

name.zh: 奧德修斯漂流至費埃阿卡島

description.en: Exhausted and battered by the sea, Odysseus reaches the coast of Phaeacia and finds shelter in the woods.
description.zh: 奧德修斯精疲力竭地抵達費埃阿卡海岸，並躲進林中休息。

events.source_excerpt: There he crept beneath two shoots of olive that grew from a single stock... Ulysses crept under these and began to make himself a bed to lie on.

description.en: Poseidon holds a grudge against Odysseus and seeks to prevent his return.
description.zh: 波塞冬對奧德修斯懷恨在心，試圖阻撓他的歸途。

description.en: Athena actively assists and protects Odysseus during his journey.
description.zh: 雅典娜在旅途中積極幫助並保護奧德修斯。

unmatched_characters.note: A marine goddess who helps Odysseus by giving him her enchanted veil.
Mentioned as the consort of Dawn; a peripheral mythological figure.
